versions.changelog: Add recalls-ymm, recalls-batch, ymm-options, and ownership.

carsxe 1.1.7

- No functional changes; documentation only update.
- Example API requests in the SKILL.md have been refreshed with more realistic image URLs.
- No code or interface updates were made to this version.

carsxe v1.1.6

- No changes detected in this release.
- Functionality, documentation, and configuration remain unchanged from the previous version.

- Changed environment variable for API key from CARSXE_API_KEY to CARSXE_KEY throughout the documentation.
- Updated instructions and code examples to use the new CARSXE_KEY variable.
- Adjusted the error handling message for missing API key to refer to CARSXE_KEY.
- No functional or endpoint changes otherwise.

carsxe 1.1.4 changelog

- Clarified API key usage: explained access in Node.js, PowerShell, and bash/zsh.
- Updated instructions for missing/invalid API key to use `openclaw config set` and restart guidance.
- Removed YAML `env` section in favor of plain-text API key handling instructions.
- Minor language improvements for request building and error handling.
- Example API requests now use generic `$CARSXE_API_KEY` placeholders instead of templated variables.

- API key usage in all documentation updated from CARSXE_API_KEY to {{env.CARSXE_API_KEY}}, reflecting a template variable format.
- All sample API URLs and authentication instructions now use the new {{env.CARSXE_API_KEY}} syntax.
- No changes to skill functionality or endpoints; update is documentation-only.

- Minor formatting and Markdown improvements to SKILL.md for consistency and readability.
- No changes to functionality, endpoints, or environment variable requirements.

**carsxe v1.1.1 Changelog**

- Updated API endpoint paths and parameters for improved accuracy (e.g., new versions: `/v2/platedecoder`, `/v1/recalls`, `/v1/lien-theft`).
- **All API requests now require appending `&source=openclaw`**.
- Clarified authentication instructions and added a dedicated API key validation endpoint.
- Expanded and detailed Quick API Map, including more optional parameters and all supported endpoints.
- Updated examples and workflow to match the latest CarsXE API structure and best practices.

- Switched API key handling to use the CARSXE_API_KEY environment variable, referenced as {{env.CARSXE_API_KEY}} in requests.
- Updated documentation to instruct users on setting the API key via environment variable, not manual input.
- Changed the market value endpoint to /v2/marketvalue and clarified its optional parameters.
- Improved error handling instructions to refer to the env var and updated authentication/help text throughout.
- No code changes; documentation and workflow updates only.

- Initial release of CarsXE skill on Clawhub.
- Added metadata file (.clawhub/origin.json) to support Clawhub integration.
- No changes to user-facing functionality or documentation.

- Added _meta.json file for skill metadata.  
- No changes to existing functionality or workflow.  
- All API docs and usage instructions remain the same.

- No code or documentation changes detected in this version.
- Functionality and behavior remain the same as the previous release.
